about_the_game:
The Dreamless Kingdom Demo showcases a vertical slice through the world, hinting towards what the full game will eventually become! Explore a world full of secrets and help restore the villagers' dreams.

This demo tasks you with reaching the village Parade, representing Act I of the 3 Act game.

name: Dreamless Kingdom Demo
short_description: In this third-person narrative adventure game you'll be tasked with finding hidden objects and untangling narrative knots with the goal of restoring a village's dreams. You'll be tasked with navigating the 3D atmospherically rich environments and assisting various characters with their dreams.
